title: Registered Analysis Execution, Deviation, Result Adjudication And Correction Registry
scope: Thirty-two inactive analysis-execution dockets, eight empty protocol-deviation registers, eight inactive result-adjudication dockets, and eight empty correction-withdrawal registers for the Phase 72 claim and design layer.
interpretation_boundary: A registered design is not an authorized execution. Reproducible execution is not a valid result. A result is not a publishable claim. Replication does not erase deviations, nulls, adverse evidence, uncertainty, corrections, or withdrawal duties. No result may be inspected or published automatically.

execution_gates.label: Registered design and authorization
execution_gates.question: The exact Phase 72 design, registration receipt, authorized question, estimand, and execution scope are present.

execution_gates.label: Frozen input snapshot
execution_gates.question: Every input, inclusion, exclusion, version, period, checksum, and lineage receipt is frozen before execution.

execution_gates.label: Code and calculation identity
execution_gates.question: The analysis repository, immutable commit, dependency graph, tests, and calculation entrypoint are identified.

execution_gates.label: Environment and runtime identity
execution_gates.question: The operating environment, package lock, container or runtime, architecture, locale, and environment digest are reproducible.

execution_gates.label: Analysis plan and estimand lock
execution_gates.question: The registered plan version, outcome, contrast, estimand, transformations, model, and decision rules match the authorized design.

execution_gates.label: Randomness and seed commitment
execution_gates.question: Random seeds, allocation material, stochastic procedures, and entropy commitments are frozen without exposing blinded results.

execution_gates.label: Runner identity and least privilege
execution_gates.question: The authorized runner, access scope, conflict status, separation of duties, and data-handling boundary are recorded.

execution_gates.label: Preflight tests and failure rules
execution_gates.question: Schema, unit, integration, negative, boundary, and expected-failure tests pass before the production run.

execution_gates.label: Blinding and masking control
execution_gates.question: Result visibility, label masking, blind-break authority, leakage tests, and prohibited inspection paths are explicit.

execution_gates.label: Immutable execution log
execution_gates.question: Start, stop, command, input, environment, warning, error, retry, and operator events are append-only and receipt-bound.

execution_gates.label: Output manifest and checksums
execution_gates.question: Every output, table, figure, diagnostic, excluded result, checksum, and retention location appears in one manifest.

execution_gates.label: Deviation and amendment capture
execution_gates.question: Planned and unplanned departures are recorded before interpretation and linked to their adjudication or amendment receipt.

execution_gates.label: Independent execution or replication
execution_gates.question: A separately authorized runner can reproduce the primary output from the frozen bundle without undisclosed intervention.

execution_gates.label: Dual review, execution receipt, and propagation
execution_gates.question: Two independent reviewers authorize the bounded execution state and complete every assigned propagation surface.

deviation_categories.label: Input, source, version, or lineage change
Outcome, variable, unit, or denominator change
Baseline, follow-up, cadence, lag, or window change
Comparison, control, matching, or donor-pool change
Model, estimator, transformation, or threshold change
Missing-data, attrition, exclusion, or censoring change
Interference, spillover, contamination, or treatment-version change
Code, dependency, environment, runtime, or execution change
Post-result, unblinding, interpretation, or disclosure change

adjudication_gates.label: Authorized execution and complete receipt
adjudication_gates.question: The adjudication resolves to a complete, authorized, reproducible Phase 73 execution bundle.

adjudication_gates.label: Blind-break authorization
adjudication_gates.question: The result was not inspected before the registered design and execution receipts authorized unblinding.

adjudication_gates.label: Primary result and estimand
adjudication_gates.question: The reported result matches the registered primary outcome, contrast, population, period, and estimand.

adjudication_gates.label: Uncertainty and precision
adjudication_gates.question: Intervals, coverage, model or sampling uncertainty, practical magnitude, and failure to distinguish effects are explicit.

adjudication_gates.label: Robustness and sensitivity
adjudication_gates.question: Every predeclared alternative specification and sensitivity result is visible, including reversals and failures.

adjudication_gates.label: Falsification and negative controls
adjudication_gates.question: Placebos, pre-trends, negative controls, balance, discontinuity, and manipulation tests are adjudicated against failure rules.

adjudication_gates.label: Null, adverse, and disconfirming results
adjudication_gates.question: Nulls, harms, reversals, exclusions, warnings, and disconfirming outputs remain attached to the result bundle.

adjudication_gates.label: Subgroups and multiplicity
adjudication_gates.question: Exploratory analyses, subgroup selection, repeated testing, family-wise decisions, and multiplicity adjustments are explicit.

adjudication_gates.label: Deviations and amendments
adjudication_gates.question: Every deviation, discovery stage, materiality assessment, amendment, impact on estimand, and reviewer disposition is visible.

adjudication_gates.label: Independent replication
adjudication_gates.question: An independent execution or replication result, differences, unresolved failures, and reproducibility limits are assessed.

adjudication_gates.label: Alternative explanations and design assumptions
adjudication_gates.question: Phase 72 alternatives, identification assumptions, confounding, spillovers, attrition, and measurement limits are revisited after execution.

adjudication_gates.label: Claim class and verb strength
adjudication_gates.question: The proposed language stays within the strongest evidence class supported after all adverse, deviation, and replication review.

adjudication_gates.label: Correction and withdrawal readiness
adjudication_gates.question: Result identity, public lineage, supersession, correction, withdrawal, and reader-notice procedures are ready before publication.

adjudication_gates.label: Dual adjudication, receipt, and propagation
adjudication_gates.question: Two independent reviewers issue one bounded claim decision and complete every assigned public and operational propagation surface.

correction_classes.label: Method, model, estimand, or design correction
Comparison, alternative-explanation, attribution, or causal correction
Disclosure, conflict, limitation, or provenance correction
